description: Land Acquisition - Amendment to the Notice Published in Gaz.Ex.ord. No. 1955/25 of 26.02.2016 by Colombo D/S Division
reasoning: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters, specifically amendments to land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed information about specific land parcels (lot numbers, assessment numbers, extents, locations), statutory compensation amounts, and related court cases. The content falls squarely under land and property-related matters as defined in Type 4, with no government personnel changes or structural administrative changes that would trigger Types 1-3.
